verdict.rationale: Anrok's 'Headless Tax' framing ('hand it to your agents') and automatic filing/registration completion imply some background automation of tax jobs, but there's no evidence of a user-configurable automation builder or scheduler for autonomous agent workflows—these are built-in backend processes, not user-set-up automations. missing for 10: explicit UI/API for defining custom autonomous triggers, evidence of independent/hands-on confirmation that agents can run unattended jobs.
